verdict.rationale: Period locking is a fair question for an accounting and bookkeeping service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions locking closed periods or requiring an explicit reopening. The only related items are a general reference to finalizing books monthly and the use of QuickBooks, which is a host platform and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can lock closed periods so prior-period numbers cannot change without an explicit reopening
